zh-CN: FloraDoc Word Preview Windows x64 试用版，支持范围不变。
修复在线更新在含空格安装路径下启动安装器失败的问题。
en: FloraDoc Word Preview trial for Windows x64; supported capabilities are unchanged.
Fixed online updates failing to launch the installer when the installation path contains spaces.

zh-CN: Windows 10 或更新版本，x64；无需安装 .NET SDK、Python 或 Microsoft Word。
en: Windows 10 or later, x64; no .NET SDK, Python, or Microsoft Word installation is required.

zh-CN: 运行 FloraDoc-Setup-win-x64.exe，按需选择当前用户或所有用户安装，重新打开终端后运行 floradoc --version。
便携 ZIP 解压后运行 floradoc.exe；便携包不配置 PATH，也不支持在线更新或安装器卸载。
en: Run FloraDoc-Setup-win-x64.exe and choose per-user or all-users installation. Reopen the terminal and run floradoc --version.
Extract the portable ZIP and run floradoc.exe. The portable package does not configure PATH or support online updates or installer uninstall.
